title: Cost sparkline microinteraction + rollout-state legend — stakeholder alignment & final QA
creator: Maya Patel
description: Polish and finalize the cost-card sparklines and the rollout-state legend used across the Dashboard and Route detail pages. This ticket consolidates feedback from PM and Eng on the microinteraction timing, hover/focus states, and the legend semantics for: stable, canary, degraded, and fallback model variants. Deliverables: final Figma frames with pixel redlines, a motion spec (duration/easing), accessibility notes (contrast, focus order), QA checklist for visual regression and cross-browser checks, and a handoff package for frontend engineers (CSS tokens, example HTML). The work aims to reduce confusion in quick cost scans and make rollout states discoverable without adding visual noise.
acceptance_criteria: Figma frames contain final sparkline states: idle, hover, selected, and loading with 1px redlines and component token references
Motion spec defines microinteraction durations: hover expand 100ms ease-out, focus pulse 250ms ease-in-out; reduced motion flag respected
Rollout-state legend uses accessible color pairings (WCAG AA) and includes an optional text label when user preference 'show labels' is on
Engineering handoff includes CSS variables, example DOM, and a small test fixture for Percy visual diffs
QA checklist items pass in Chrome, Firefox, Safari (latest stable) on macOS and Windows, and on viewport widths 360px/768px/1440px
updates: 2026-02-12 — Ticket created by Maya after sync with PM; initial scope defined and estimate set to 3 points.
2026-02-16 — Early review: PM (Ava Thompson) suggested changing canary color from orange to amber to avoid conflict with error states; approved by Design lead (Maya).

2026-02-18 — Engineering feasibility sync: ENG (Sofia Martinez) raised concern about SVG stroke animations impacting CPU on low-end devices; accepted alternate: CSS transform for hover emphasis and an option to disable animations via prefers-reduced-motion. Added dependency ENG-1972 for perf gating.
2026-02-24 — Prototype uploaded: interactive Figma prototype v1 with hover and focus flows. Link shared with stakeholders for a quick pass.
2026-02-28 — Design critique: Requested tighter pixel grid alignment for sparklines (snap to 4px grid) and reduced stroke from 2px to 1.5px for compact cost cards. Action: prepare redline frames.
